name: gstack
description: Office hours, autoplan, ship, land-and-deploy, qa, security/health audits. Includes the core git workflow from Basics.

actions.label: Office hours
actions.description: YC-style interrogation or builder brainstorm to pressure-test the idea.

actions.label: Autoplan
actions.description: Run CEO, design, eng, and DX plan reviews in sequence with a single approval gate.

actions.label: Investigate
actions.description: Systematic root-cause debugging: investigate → analyze → hypothesize → implement.

actions.label: Health check
actions.description: Wraps type-check, lint, tests, dead-code into a weighted 0-10 score.

actions.label: QA
actions.description: QA-test a running web app and fix bugs found.

actions.label: Security audit
actions.description: OWASP Top 10, STRIDE, secrets archaeology, supply-chain checks.

actions.label: Review
actions.description: Pre-landing PR review: SQL safety, LLM trust boundary, conditional side effects.

actions.label: Ship
actions.description: Full ship workflow: run tests, bump version, update changelog, commit, push, open PR.

actions.label: Land & deploy
actions.description: Merge PR, wait for CI/deploy, verify production health via canary.

actions.label: Commit
actions.description: Commit current changes without invoking the full /ship workflow.
actions.template: Commit the current changes with a clear message. Don't commit any files that contain secrets.

actions.label: Resolve conflicts
actions.description: Resolve merge conflicts, asking before guessing.
actions.template: Resolve the current merge conflicts. Ask before guessing on anything ambiguous.

actions.label: Sync
actions.description: Pull the latest from main and fix conflicts.
actions.template: Pull the latest from {main} into this branch and fix any conflicts.
